name: Find your frames
starting_position: You begin on bottom in side control.
user_objective: Recover guard or come to a seated position.
reset_condition: Reset on guard recovery or sitting up. Otherwise continue until the round ends.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Rehearse a forearm frame at the shoulder and a hip-side frame without resistance.
Try a small hip escape to make room for a knee, then reconnect your guard.

partner_variants.lower: Partner starts with settled chest contact; build your frames from there.
partner_variants.similar: Start with light chest contact and your elbows close to your body.
partner_variants.higher: Start with your frames established and space for your near knee; partner cannot isolate your arms.

name: Escape the arm isolation
starting_position: You begin on bottom in side control.
user_objective: Prevent arm isolation and recover guard or turtle.
partner_objective: Maintain the pin and isolate an arm without applying a lock.
reset_condition: Reset after escape; release arm control immediately if it strains the shoulder.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Practice keeping elbows near your ribs and building a safe frame.
Explore turning onto your side and inserting your knee when space appears.

partner_variants.lower: Partner starts with connected hands; you begin with elbows close.
partner_variants.similar: Partner begins with loose chest contact and no isolated arm.
partner_variants.higher: Begin on your side with a hip frame; partner may not connect hands.

name: Clear the knee shield
starting_position: You begin on top in knee-shield half guard.
user_objective: Clear the knee shield while remaining engaged.
partner_objective: Keep the knee between your bodies.
reset_condition: Reset once the knee shield is cleared. Do not continue to a submission.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Rehearse controlling the shielding leg without twisting the knee.
Try changing angle and closing space as the shield clears.

partner_variants.lower: Partner begins with a strong knee shield and both frames.
partner_variants.similar: Start with a knee shield and light upper-body frames.
partner_variants.higher: Start with the shield partly cleared; partner begins with one frame.

name: Free the trapped leg
starting_position: You begin on top in half guard.
user_objective: Free your trapped leg and settle past the guard.
partner_objective: Remove your underhooks and recover a knee shield.
reset_condition: Reset after a pass or knee-shield recovery.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Rehearse maintaining balance before trying to free your knee.
Try gradually clearing the knee line while keeping controlled upper-body connection.

partner_variants.lower: Begin with no underhook; partner has an established head-side frame.
partner_variants.similar: Begin with one underhook and the partner’s head-side frame.
partner_variants.higher: Begin with two light underhooks and your knee close to clearing.

name: Stay connected
starting_position: You begin on top in chest-to-chest side control.
user_objective: Maintain chest contact and controlled positional balance.
partner_objective: Insert knees or feet, sit up, or reverse.
reset_condition: Reset when partner escapes. Top’s task is continuous; no invented hold-time score.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Rehearse following a slow hip turn without squeezing harder.
Explore adjusting your base as your partner changes direction.

partner_variants.lower: Partner begins on their side with frames established.
partner_variants.similar: Begin with light chest contact and no isolated arm.
partner_variants.higher: Begin with settled chest contact; partner starts flat with elbows close.

name: Follow the transition
starting_position: You begin on top in side control.
user_objective: Move to north-south or opposite side control and hold for three seconds.
partner_objective: Insert knees or feet, or reverse.
reset_condition: Reset after a three-second controlled transition or partner escape.
rules: No submissions. Stay within the starting position’s task.
Use controlled resistance; reset rather than force a trapped joint.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance before starting. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
No explosive bridging, neck cranks, slams, or jumping movements.
technique_hints: Walk around the head slowly while maintaining comfortable chest contact.
Change your base before moving; avoid loading the neck.

partner_variants.lower: Partner starts with frames and one knee near the inside space.
partner_variants.similar: Start in light side control with partner’s elbows close.
partner_variants.higher: Start near north-south with comfortable chest contact.

name: Find the knee
starting_position: Both start standing without grips; you are the attacker.
user_objective: Make repeated light touches to either knee without grabbing or driving through.
partner_objective: Use distance, movement, and hands to deny knee touches.
reset_condition: Continuous light-touch task; return to comfortable distance after each touch and continue. No takedown score.
rules: No submissions, jumping entries, slams, sacrifice throws, or forced joint twisting.
Use only familiar, coached movements. No completed takedowns or lifts. Stay standing; stop and reset if balance is lost.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance and boundaries. Use a clear, suitable matted area away from other pairs. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
Release a trapped leg rather than twist a planted knee. No neck pulling. Keep movement controlled; do not force a fall.
technique_hints: Rehearse stance movement and a small level change without diving forward.
Explore timing a light touch as your partner moves; stay balanced.

partner_variants.lower: Partner starts at a little more distance and may use light hand contact to deny access.
partner_variants.similar: Start at mutually agreed light-touch distance without grips.
partner_variants.higher: Partner begins within easy reach and initially defends with footwork only.

name: Keep the single-leg connection
starting_position: You begin standing as attacker with one of your partner’s legs held between your legs.
user_objective: Maintain the single-leg connection while moving slowly together.
partner_objective: Stay balanced on the free foot and free the captured leg.
reset_condition: Reset when the partner frees the leg, or immediately when either player loses balance. Your connection task is continuous.
rules: No submissions, jumping entries, slams, sacrifice throws, or forced joint twisting.
Use only familiar, coached movements. No completed takedowns or lifts. Stay standing; stop and reset if balance is lost.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance and boundaries. Use a clear, suitable matted area away from other pairs. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
Release a trapped leg rather than twist a planted knee. No neck pulling. Keep movement controlled; do not force a fall.
technique_hints: Start with cooperative balance and a light connection; do not raise the leg high.
Explore small steps while keeping your own posture and allowing the partner to move safely.

partner_variants.lower: Begin with a shallow connection; partner may immediately work to free the leg.
partner_variants.similar: Begin with a light established single-leg connection and stable balance.
partner_variants.higher: Begin with the connection comfortably established; partner first uses gentle movement rather than hand-fighting.

name: Connect the body lock
starting_position: Both start standing with reciprocal underhooks; you are working to connect your hands.
user_objective: Get inside or behind the elbows and join your hands behind the partner’s back.
partner_objective: Deny your hand connection and seek their own body lock.
reset_condition: Reset immediately when either player joins hands behind the back. No squeeze, lift, or throw after the connection.
rules: No submissions, jumping entries, slams, sacrifice throws, or forced joint twisting.
Use only familiar, coached movements. No completed takedowns or lifts. Stay standing; stop and reset if balance is lost.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance and boundaries. Use a clear, suitable matted area away from other pairs. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
Release a trapped leg rather than twist a planted knee. No neck pulling. Keep movement controlled; do not force a fall.
technique_hints: Rehearse moving your hands inside the elbows with light contact.
Move your feet to find an angle rather than wrenching the shoulder.

partner_variants.lower: Partner begins with better inside elbow position; you work to recover access.
partner_variants.similar: Start with reciprocal underhooks and equal inside position.
partner_variants.higher: Start with one hand already behind the partner’s back; partner gently denies the second hand.

name: Single-leg off-balance
starting_position: You begin as attacker in a captured single leg, with both partners balanced and ready.
user_objective: Maintain connection and guide the partner onto hands or hips with a slow, controlled off-balance.
partner_objective: Maintain balance and free the captured leg.
reset_condition: Reset after controlled contact of hands or hips with the mat, or when the leg is freed. Release and reset if the descent cannot be controlled.
rules: No submissions, jumping entries, slams, sacrifice throws, or forced joint twisting.
Use only familiar, coached movements. Only a slow, controlled descent to hands or hips is allowed; no lifts or airborne finishes.
safety_constraints: Agree on resistance and boundaries. Use a clear, suitable matted area away from other pairs. Stop on any tap, pain, or request.
Release a trapped leg rather than twist a planted knee. No neck pulling. Both partners must already know how to receive the movement safely; otherwise use the connection-only game.
technique_hints: Cooperatively rehearse a familiar, coached off-balance and safe receiving movement first.
Explore small angle changes without twisting the planted knee or lifting the partner.

partner_variants.lower: Begin with a shallow capture; partner can use light hand-fighting immediately.
partner_variants.similar: Begin with an established single-leg connection and gentle resistance.
partner_variants.higher: Begin from a comfortable connection and agreed favorable angle; partner uses light balance recovery.
